scientific_scope: This fixture arena tests whether one shared charge-conditional flow trained from a utility-tilted empirical proposal reproduces the declared tilted target for both charges while retaining measurable nominal coverage. It is not a physical-rate estimate, does not treat B_toy as a physical endpoint, does not treat U_A as a calibrated acceptance probability, does not claim FairShip acceptance, and declares no universal winner. FairShip/GEANT4 remains the final physical oracle.
